title: viola pedunculata var. tenuifolia
intro: Viola pedunculata var. tenuifolia, commonly known as Chinese violet or yellow viola, is a type of flowering plant in the viola genus, characterized by its yellow flowers and heart-shaped leaves. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Viola pedunculata var. tenuifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
